name: Buttons – Build Floating, Social Share & Print Buttons Easily
author: Wow-Company

sections.description:
The Buttons for makes it simple to create and manage beautiful, interactive buttons. Whether you need standard call-to-action buttons, floating action buttons, social sharing buttons, or print buttons, this plugin gives you full control over design, placement, and functionality.

Customize your buttons with live preview, icons, and flexible styling. Place buttons anywhere — before/after content, inside posts with shortcodes, or fixed on the screen as floating buttons. Built-in social sharing and print features help you boost engagement, improve navigation, and make content more interactive.

Key Features

🎨 Design and Customization

  • Live Builder Interface: Design and preview buttons in real time with an intuitive builder.
  • Comprehensive Styling: Adjust colors, size, text, backgrounds, borders, and effects.
  • Icon Integration: Use Font Awesome 7 or add custom icons.
  • Flexible Placement: Insert buttons via shortcode, before/after content, or fixed on screen.

⚡ Enhanced Button Functionality

  • Unlimited Buttons: Create as many buttons as your site needs.
  • Duplication Tool: Save time by cloning existing buttons.
  • Targeted Linking: Add login, logout, registration, password reset, or custom links.
  • Social Sharing Buttons: Share content across Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, and more.
  • Print Button: Allow visitors to instantly print your pages with one click.
  • Email Share Button: Let users send page links via email.
  • Floating Buttons: Keep key actions visible while scrolling.
  • One-Click Enable/Disable: Manage button visibility with ease.
  • Test Mode: Preview buttons privately before publishing.
  • Open Links in New Window: Control how links behave on click.
  • Organized Navigation: Use custom tags to group and find buttons quickly.

The Buttons is an all-in-one tool for creating engaging, functional buttons in WordPress. From call-to-action and floating buttons to social share and print buttons, it helps you drive interaction, boost clicks, and improve user experience.
sections.installation:
In WordPress:

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New > search for buttons
  2. Press Install Now for the Button plugin
  3. Press Activate Plugin

Manual installation:

  1. Upload the button directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Can I Use the Plugin on a Multisite Network

Yes, you can, but you need to activate the plugin separately on each subsite.

How Do I Add Icons to My Buttons

The Buttons plugin seamlessly integrates with Font Awesome, allowing you to effortlessly add thousands of beautiful icons to your buttons. Simply search the Font Awesome library (Font Awesome: https://fontawesome.com/icons) and use the icon class to incorporate it into your button design.
